kuaishou-user-insight 1.0.0

- Initial release of a KuaiShou (Kuaishou) user insight and product opportunity analysis tool focused on public data.
- Supports three main functions: video keyword search, creator post monitoring via homepage/user_id, and video comment analysis.
- Flexible filters available for sorting, time, duration, and result limits.
- Does not access non-public/private data; no login or interaction capabilities.
- Requires configuration of GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for API access.
- Provides structured JSON output and clear error/status reporting for all results.
